citations.assessment: Rav Neḥemyah son of Yosef explicitly gives a measure for the cleansing mixture.
Neḥemyah son of Rav Yosef is named in redemption with produce of equivalent value. The Mar Zutra question below is a separate Chullin passage.
Chullin gives the exact speakers and question and names Rav Neḥemyah son of Rav Yosef explicitly. The printed abbreviation is preserved while the parallel names its referent.
The wife is that of Rav Yosef son of Rava. She appears before a different figure, Rav Neḥemyah son of Rav Yosef. The current English keeps those roles.
The first report has the son of Rav Yehoshua find two men; the alternate report has the son of Yosef find three. Retain the difference rather than harmonizing.
The receiving entry gives the first report about Pappi and Pappa. Both versions appear in the same digital Bavli passage.
Neḥemyah son of Rav Yosef says he was standing before Rava. This establishes the report without inferring a formal teacher relationship.
Neḥemyah sends the named recipient the instruction concerning a woman’s tenth share.
The parallel names sender and recipient with the Zuti form and attaches Nehardea to the transmission.
The target expressly reports the Neḥemyah form in the Rosh as a variant of the Hamnuna passage.

holds.reason: The related entry gives the same proposed lineage, but the consulted Sanhedrin text explicitly has Rav Dimi son of Rav Naḥman son of Rav Yosef. Preserve the discrepant patronymic.
